fixture: Fictional medicine student; fresh guide completed via the UI
method: A fresh fictional student completed every displayed question through browser UI; the same draft continued after the repeated-introduction fix. Section boundaries were rechecked after rebuilding.

viewports.role: Career matches, profile review and saved plan round trip

findingsFixed: Read introductions repeated when using Back or crossing a section again.
Early follow-up and experience screens repeated the introduction as a banner.

automatedTests.scope: Full focused/all-question routes, transition replay, question order, saved state, matching invariance, rendering and restart checks.

limits: Phone-sized browser viewports; no physical iPhone or Android device used.
Browser-local persistence tested. Production sign-in and cloud synchronization were not exercised.
One realistic UI student route; not a psychometric validation or a claim that every student profile was tested.
